name: Mah Sing Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Mah Sing Group Berhad 在房地产板块继续通过收购土地扩大版图，包括在 Senai、Johor 约419.17英亩土地（GDV约RM2.26 billion）、Semenyih 275英亩土地、Ampang 14.3775英亩土地以及 Setapak 2.79英亩土地；同时完成收购 Jalan Ampang 的 Corus Hotel 地块（GDV约RM1.28 billion）。此外，现金代价 RM617.86 million。
overview_en: In 2026, Mah Sing Group Berhad continued to expand its property segment through land acquisitions, including approximately 419.17 acres in Senai, Johor (estimated GDV of approximately RM2.26 billion), 275 acres in Semenyih, 14.3775 acres in Ampang and 2.79 acres in Setapak; it also completed the acquisition of the Corus Hotel site along Jalan Ampang (estimated GDV of approximately RM1.28 billion).

segments.name: 房地产
segments.note: 今年继续通过收购土地扩大住宅和综合项目发展版图。
segments.note_en: The segment continued to expand its residential and mixed-development land bank through acquisitions this year, while proposing the disposal of certain land.
